data.name: The Bestest Knight
data.detailed_description:
The Bestest Knight is a loot-driven auto scroller RPG with hybrid action and auto-battle combat, packed with monsters, unlockables, and deep build variety.

Begin as a young, inexperienced stable boy with a dream and rise beyond every expectation.

Go on an adventure to the end of the world, earn gold and experience, discover new recipes, treasures, dungeons,
and invest in your character.
As your knight-rank grows, so do your possibilities, unlocking new mechanics, upgradeable gear,
and new areas in your hometown.

Almost everything is upgradeable: weapons, armor, launchers (to kickstart your adventures),
potions, attributes, horses… you name it!
Each upgrade doesn’t just improve stats, it also grants new abilities and a brand-new look at max level.
You can also craft new items, but first, you need the right recipe, found either during your adventures or in dungeons.

Before heading out, explore your hub area. Greet your neighbors, prepare for your journey, and discover new ways to strengthen your knight.
At first, the townspeople won’t trust you. Prove yourself, and they may offer helpful tools, tips, and upgrades. Keep your eyes open!

Step through the big iron gate and a new adventure begins… filled with treacherous traps, obstacles,
monsters, and opportunities.
Watch your health and stamina -> if either drops to zero, your adventure ends
and you return to town with your earnings.
With luck, you might even find treasures or new recipes.
Every journey brings you closer to your goal and makes you stronger, but the farther you go, the more dangerous the world becomes.

Fights blend auto battle and action combat into a flexible system.
You attack automatically based on your attack speed while building charge during combat
that unlocks powerful special actions.

These actions behave in unique ways such as dealing extra damage to stunned enemies, striking multiple times in quick succession, or even parrying incoming attacks.

Your action loadout is fully customizable and frequently used actions can even level up over time.

If you prefer a less action focused approach you can use Spells instead. These trigger automatically based on your cast speed but consume more stamina.

Overall it is a colorful mix of auto and active combat that lets you choose your own playstyle, whether aggressive, defensive, idle, or more action focused.

During your journeys, you’ll find treasure items that grant up to 4 random stat boosts and unique abilities.
Some treasures even change game mechanics in interesting ways, opening up new strategies.
Experiment to your heart’s content!

At key points in your journey, you’ll discover dungeons -> short, optional mini-adventures with tougher enemies, dungeon-specific recipes, treasures, and powerful bosses.
Defeating bosses grants passive abilities, so explore them fully.
Discovered dungeons can be accessed anytime via the teleporter in your hometown.

data.short_description: Travel to the end of the world in this auto scroller RPG. Craft unique builds, discover powerful item combos, and transform your fragile stable boy into the Bestest Knight.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8.1, 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E4500 (2 * 2200) or equivalent, AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual Core 3600+ (2 * 1910) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 7300 GT (512 MB), Radeon X1300 Pro (256 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8.1, 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E6750 (2 * 2660) or equivalent, AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual Core 5000+ (2 * 2600) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 8600 GT (512 MB), Radeon HD 4650 (1024 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
